additional_band_rule.note: Apply only above net_lodging_price_above. Add base_charge once, then charge_per_started_block for each started price_block_size above that threshold. Formula transcribed from the law; no computed examples or averaged values.

assessment_base.excludes: VAT and separately identifiable non-lodging services.
assessment_base.allocation: Use the legally applicable allocation to each occupant, not automatically the room total. Provider/intermediary settlement can differ from the traveller gross package price.
assessment_base.note: Fallback assessment rules exist and the classification values change in 2027. They are not encoded as calculable shapes here. If actual assessment consideration cannot be established, refuse; do not use a star-rating average or the observed retail room price as a substitute.

applicability.grandfathering: The older schedule remains applicable to qualifying earlier agreements after the new schedule commences. Accordingly to=null is intentional; agreement-date bounds select the schedule. Bookings before 2025 are not encoded and must be refused.

periods.exemptions: No general exemption for age or business purpose. Basic emergency housing and specified medical/care institutions are outside scope. Short-term accommodation is less than two months. Tax debtor is the lodging business; guest pass-through is not automatic. See official guidance https://www.hamburg.de/resource/blob/207446/2031651327b6dd26e60b0b3266433d3e/ktt-merkblatt-data.pdf

calculation.supported_case: Statutory tax, using actual known net assessment consideration per person/night and an agreement selected by the encoded date rules.
calculation.structural_dependency: Exact statutory-liability mode requires an actual legal assessment base. Planning mode instead uses the approved inclusive accommodation allowance and never adds this tax.
calculation.exact_charge_scope_note: Existing supported_case, required_inputs and evidence_gaps describe exact statutory/invoice mode only. The prior model-derived tax proposal was superseded by the owner’s inclusive allowance decision on 2026-11-02.

unresolved: Research only: this is not the production cost schema and the app must never read it. A validated transform must reject unconfirmed and disputed records, and retain all product, geography, date, eligibility and purchase-channel restrictions on confirmed records.

research-v3: transit envelopes carry validity_area. Airport transfers use journey_legs and named taxi_tariffs categories; overall journey time, estimated taxi ranges and attraction visit durations are deliberately absent. Each taxi category has base_fare, per_km, per_waiting_minute and airport_surcharge envelopes. An optional published_waiting_rate preserves an hourly source without deriving a per-minute figure.

Prices are observations checked on the collection date, not promises for a future trip. A current official page without an explicit effective date is identified as such. No currency conversion, averages, estimated amounts or arithmetic replacement for a missing product are used. Null does not mean zero.

day_pass records only an explicitly specified validity product; service-day and consecutive-hour products must not be treated as interchangeable. pass_72h is not calculated from shorter passes. Nonexistence requires positive evidence, not an unsuccessful search.

Eating-out figures are named menu observations, not representative city averages. A published per-person menu has not been doubled to manufacture a two-person total. The midrange category is not an official restaurant classification.

The five attractions are a research selection rather than a verified popularity ranking. Booking evidence is placed in entry_price.note because the agreed boolean has no envelope. Null booking status is unknown; no availability or queue-time claim is made.

An empty accommodation_charges array means no non-statutory charge was verified in this research, not that every property is fee-free. Conditional levies must be matched to an actual property; universal=false forbids automatic addition to every trip.

Airport scope follows destination codes found in repository configuration/catalogue, not an independently verified live origin-flight schedule. Named endpoint fares are not terminal-to-hotel prices. No comparison claim is made where cheaper conditional products or alternate services remain unverified.
Tax booking-date grandfathering applies across both the 2025 and 2027 changes. A transform keyed only by overnight date would be incorrect.
The day product expires the next morning rather than after 24 hours. Its explicit unit and note must be enforced; it cannot satisfy a strict rolling-hour input.
No current official coffee price or airport-specific fixed taxi price was verified. No estimated substitute supplied.

The approved banded representation is now populated from enacted law for 2025 and 2027. The scalar null is structural, not an absent tariff. Agreement-date selectors preserve grandfathering; to=null does not mean both schedules apply to the same booking.

Exact statutory assessment is supported only for known actual net consideration and agreements in the encoded periods. Historical pre-2025 rates and statutory fallback assessment rules are deliberately flagged unsupported; no approximation is allowed.

A statutory tax amount is not automatically an additional guest charge. Confirm property pass-through, whether already included in the quote, and applicable VAT before adding anything to a trip total.

research-v4 adds the closed tax basis registry and calculation metadata. Conditional means the recorded formula supports only its named case with all required inputs; it does not mean a guest total is ready. Unknown basis, unsupported assessment, missing inputs and unresolved evidence must cause explicit refusal, never an average, nearest-shape mapping or zero.

Conditional reframing: this tax depends structurally on the accommodation model. The registry proposes a derived tax component with the stay estimate’s provenance and an explicit incomplete-total state whenever a required charge cannot be represented. No actual room quote is expected from city research; no production calculator or result-card change is made here.

2026-11-02 owner decision supersedes the earlier model-derived tax proposal: statutory accommodation tax is inside the traveller-payable allowance and must never be added again. Exact legal research remains for plausibility/inclusion checks and future provider reconciliation; no tax transform is implemented.
